title: Bedrock Color Codes
description: Bring the iconic Bedrock Edition color formatting codes to Minecraft Java. Easily style your signs, books, and chat with classic color and formatting symbols.
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1287d6dd24341ec87d60b560ae45d2cab5cd360f.png)

Bring the classic Bedrock Edition color formatting to Java Edition!

Have you ever wanted to use those iconic Bedrock color codes (§ symbols) in your Java Minecraft experience? Bedrock Color Codes Mod makes it possible, allowing you to use familiar formatting codes for signs, books, and chat with ease.

![In game look of the mod functionality on signs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/74ca51f345ce92f05c6e5e758358fc4a33d5de10_0.webp)
Whether you're a map maker, a server admin, or just someone who loves the Bedrock aesthetic, this mod is designed to give you that extra layer of customization.

Features:

Seamless Integration: Adds support for standard Bedrock color and formatting codes.

Lightweight: Designed to be efficient and compatible with other mods.

Versatile: Works on signs, writable books, and in-game chat.

Why did I make this?
As a designer, I’ve always been drawn to the aesthetic choices in Minecraft. I wanted to bring that specific "Bedrock feel" into my Java modding projects, and I decided to share this tool with the community.

Support my work:
If you enjoy this mod and want to see more creative projects, feel free to support me on Patreon! Your support helps me keep creating, studying, and bringing new ideas to life.
